subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar, com a ajuda do professor, o texto que será produzido, considerando a situação comunicativa, os interlocutores (quem escreve/para quem escreve); a finalidade ou o propósito (escrever para quê); a circulação (onde o texto vai circular); o suporte (qual é o portador do texto); a linguagem, organização e forma do texto e seu tema, pesquisando em meios impressos ou digitais, sempre que for preciso, informações necessárias à produção do texto, organizando em tópicos os dados e as fontes pesquisadas.

components.description_pt: Planejar uma produção escrita considerando propósito e público-alvo antes do rascunho
components.description_en: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

components.description_pt: Selecionar linguagem, organização e forma apropriadas conforme circulação do texto
components.description_en: Select appropriate language, organization, and form based on where a text will circulate
components.cc_component_description: Adapt writing purpose and form to varied discipline-specific tasks and audiences

components.description_pt: Coletar informações de fontes impressas e digitais para tópico de pesquisa
components.description_en: Gather information from print and digital sources for a research topic
components.cc_component_description: Gather information from print and digital sources for a research topic

components.description_pt: Organizar dados coletados e fontes em anotações para apoiar produção textual planejada
components.description_en: Organize gathered data and sources into notes to support planned text production
components.cc_component_description: Summarize or paraphrase gathered information accurately in notes and finished writing

cc_matches.description: With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
Recall information from experiences or gather information from print and digital sources; take brief notes on sources and sort evidence into provided categories.

Write routinely over extended time frames (time for research, reflection, and revision) and shorter time frames (a single sitting or a day or two) for a range of discipline-specific tasks, purposes, and audiences.

Recall relevant information from experiences or gather relevant information from print and digital sources; summarize or paraphrase information in notes and finished work, and provide a list of sources.
